questions.question: If a ball is thrown upwards with a certain velocity, and it rises to a height of 40 meters and returns to the thrower, then:

options.text: The total distance covered by it is 40 meters.
The total displacement covered by it is 80 meters.
The total distance covered by it is zero.

questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

__

• **Distance:** It is the **total path length** traveled by an object. It is a **scalar quantity**. | SI unit: **m** | Dimensional formula: [L¹]

• **Displacement:** It is the **shortest straight-line distance** between the **initial** and **final positions** of an object. It is a **vector quantity**. | SI unit: **m** | Dimensional formula: [L¹]

 

**Calculation:**__

**Given:**

Maximum height reached, h = 40 m

Total distance = Path length (upward) + Path length (downward)

⇒ Total distance = 40 m + 40 m

⇒ Total distance = 80 m

Now, for displacement:

Initial position = Hand of the thrower

Final position = Hand of the thrower

⇒ Displacement = Final position − Initial position

⇒ Displacement = 0 m

**∴ Its displacement is zero.**

questions.question:
Select the related word from the options given below:

Transport : Goods :: Bank : _______
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Purpose of the Service**.

Here,

Transport : Goods → **Transport** is used for the movement or delivery of **Goods**.

Similarly,

Bank : Money → **Bank** is a financial institution used for the transaction or storage of **Money**.

While **Pound**, **Rupees**, and **Dollar** are specific types of currency, **Money** is the general term that fits the relationship established by goods.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.

questions.question: Who has been the owner of the Kolkata IPL team 'Kolkata Knight Riders' since February 2018?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shahrukh Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **Kolkata Knight Riders** (KKR) is a franchise cricket team representing the city of **Kolkata** in the **Indian Premier League** (IPL).

• The franchise is owned by the **Knight Riders Group**, which is a partnership between **Red Chillies Entertainment** and the **Mehta Group**.

• **Shahrukh Khan**, through his production house **Red Chillies Entertainment**, has been the primary owner of the team since its inception in **2008** and remains the owner as of **February 2018** and beyond.

• The ownership structure includes **Shahrukh Khan** (Red Chillies Entertainment) holding a **55 percent** stake and **Juhi Chawla** along with her husband **Jay Mehta** (Mehta Group) holding a **45 percent** stake.

• The team plays its home matches at the iconic **Eden Gardens** stadium in **Kolkata**, which is one of the oldest and largest cricket grounds in **India**.

• Under the ownership of **Shahrukh Khan** and the **Mehta Group**, the team has won the **IPL title** multiple times, specifically in **2012**, **2014**, and **2024**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Aamir Khan**:

• A prominent **Indian actor** and filmmaker who is not an owner of any **IPL** franchise.

• **Subrata Roy**:

• The late founder of **Sahara India Pariwar**, who previously owned the **Pune Warriors India** franchise in the **IPL** before it was terminated.

• **Sourav Ganguly**:

• The former **Indian National Cricket Team** captain and former **BCCI President**. He served as the **Captain** and **Icon Player** for **KKR** in the initial years but does not hold ownership stakes.

</ul
